title: GeneratedSecureString construct: create-only random SecureString custom resource
description: Part of story chatticus-a170754a (Secrets and generated keys live in SSM Parameter Store SecureString, created by infrastructure code); read its description for the full plan, order and hazards. New CDK construct in infra/lib with a Provider-framework Lambda: Create generates a crypto.randomBytes value and PutParameter SecureString Standard Overwrite false (adopt if it exists); Update and Delete no-ops; response excludes the value; handler role ssm:PutParameter on the exact ARN; never logs the value. Unit tests assert the template holds no value and no kms grant is needed with aws/ssm. Prerequisite for the operator key and signing key tasks.
